core1b.fresh_task: An ideal eye has retinal distance 2.5 cm from its effective lens. Find required total power for distant object and object 50 cm away.
core1b.protected_work: Use a fixed image-plane thin-lens approximation and identify its limits.

stages.attempt: An ideal eye has retinal distance 2.5 cm from its effective lens. Find required total power for distant object and object 50 cm away.
stages.reconstruct: P∞=1/.025=40 D; P50=1/.025+1/.5=42 D; near viewing requires +2 D accommodation.

stages.repair: Keep v fixed, use reciprocal object distance in metres.
stages.boundary_test: Does the model describe all aberrations, corneal shape or individual eye anatomy?

core1b.fresh_task: Draw parallel rays for distance vision and diverging rays for near vision entering an effective eye with fixed retina. Show how accommodation changes focus.

stages.attempt: Draw parallel rays for distance vision and diverging rays for near vision entering an effective eye with fixed retina. Show how accommodation changes focus.
stages.reconstruct: Relaxed eye focuses parallel rays on retina. Near rays need more converging power; with same relaxed power they would converge behind retina, increased power brings focus forward onto retina.
